purpose: Author Meshy Ready and T-pose saber hold in Blender, then export a small transform contract for Pose Lab to consume.
authority: local headless Blender review artifacts plus human approval

blender.reason: Pose Lab recovery should use terminal-runnable local Blender first, including Blender inside proot-distro Debian as used by tanks-for-the-memories. If local/proot Blender is unavailable or fails, report that blocker instead of silently falling back to a remote UI host.

acceptance: T-pose remains the canary and must not be degraded.
Ready must read as a character holding the sword, not merely as a visible weapon.
WeaponGrip must be parented to RightHand.
The sabre mesh must be parented below WeaponGrip.
Pose Lab may not retarget, solve, or tune this exported weapon hold while importing it.
